project.name: osgi/domain-annotations
project.description: Cross-cutting domain annotations common to ALL domains, depending on nothing — so any bundle (even a type=record leaf under the purity guard) may target them without a dependency, and no domain couples to another's annotation module. @Transitional: a type still lives under the OLD model while a spec describes its successor (planned refactor, not a permanent compat shim). @GovernedBy(Gate, EnforcementLevel): repeatable on a domain's root package-info, declares the reporting level (ERROR default = locked, WARN = visible backlog, IGNORE) for each build-time staging gate (RECORD_PURITY, SPEC_COVERAGE, INSTANCE_DISCIPLINE). All read by the staging extension in bytecode.
